topics.name: Scientific AI agents
topics.summary: Agentic research systems combine multimodal extraction, typed records, provenance links, and explicit failure logs to support biomedical literature curation. The recurring emphasis is inspectable evidence that can be revisited across experiments.

topics.name: LLM agent orchestration and reliability
topics.summary: Agent controllers are evaluated and improved with workflow graphs, tool-call interventions, counterfactual tests, external verifiers, and selective state synchronization. Across long tasks, structured routing and short reliable tool sequences outperform unexamined loops.

topics.name: Personalized and memory-augmented language agents
topics.summary: Personalized agents use feedback-trained memory selection, recurrent summaries, dependency-aware retrieval, and continual skill updates. Travel and evolving-preference tasks show that useful personalization depends on retaining the right facts while revising plans.

topics.name: LLM safety and adversarial robustness
topics.summary: Safety studies probe obfuscated requests, honeypot interactions, long-context attacks, prompt compression, and service-boundary failures. Detectors and boundary-aware filters help, but behavior still depends strongly on intent, context, and downstream actions.

topics.name: AI assurance and governance
topics.summary: Assurance frameworks combine runtime evidence, reproducibility checks, training-integrity controls, document and citation verification, and procurement or whistleblowing policies. Their common goal is an auditable basis for decisions about high-stakes AI.

topics.name: Language-model evaluation and calibration
topics.summary: Language-model evaluation uses deterministic consistency tests, peer questioning, annotation-disagreement analysis, calibration curves, and model-based quality scores. The studies show that confidence, coverage, fairness, and usefulness can diverge under different prompts and raters.

topics.name: Clinical language models and multimodal decision support
topics.summary: Clinical language systems combine explicit protocols, cross-agent checking, dementia or phenotype signals, and expert imaging descriptions. Results favor localized verification and audience-aware output, while incomplete rule coverage and difficult clinical reasoning remain limitations.

topics.name: Software engineering with language models
topics.summary: LLM software tools are tested on evolving repositories, where knowledge-graph updates, generated tests, local refactors, and later maintenance tasks expose weaknesses hidden by one-shot code benchmarks. Smaller, well-validated changes are generally easier to sustain.

topics.name: LLM data curation and schema enrichment
topics.summary: Curation pipelines use language models to infer schema meaning, normalize noisy records, and label clinical terms, then apply hygiene checks and rule-based or provenance validation. Hybrid review improves precision when generated structure becomes training data.

topics.name: Controlled language-model inference and reasoning
topics.summary: Controlled generation studies examine constrained decoding, verifier-linked rationales, reasoning granularity, and weight-free test-time adaptation. They find that formal structure and inference-time updates can help, but poor constraint alignment or coarse compression can damage correctness.

topics.name: Efficient language-model inference and retrieval
topics.summary: Efficient serving and retrieval methods address tail latency, memory pressure, quantization cost, and topology-aware search. Distribution-sensitive scheduling, multiplier-free embedding transforms, and spectral indexes improve practical throughput without assuming active parameters tell the whole story.

topics.name: Educational dialogue systems
topics.summary: Math tutoring models are aligned with scaffolding and correctness, while annotated middle-school peer conversations support dialogue-act analysis. Together, the datasets and generation tasks highlight the difficulty of measuring helpful collaboration rather than answer accuracy alone.

topics.name: Multilingual language-model benchmarking
topics.summary: Hindi speech and Arabic language evaluations use diverse speakers, multiple transcription references, and controlled zero-shot tasks. The results expose gaps caused by orthography, dialect and demographic variation, and culturally specific instruction behavior.

topics.name: LLM simulation of human behavior
topics.summary: Profile-conditioned language agents simulate social-media users and counseling clients using staged disclosure, task prompts, and human-oriented assessments. Fidelity improves with grounding and goals, yet model choice can make simulated populations overly uniform.

topics.name: Out-of-distribution robot manipulation
topics.summary: Manipulation policies are stress-tested under compositional task changes, novel objects, altered environments, and cross-factor shifts. Video-action-value coordination helps, but familiar benchmark performance overstates transfer to combinations not seen during training.

topics.name: Flow-based robot policy optimization
topics.summary: Flow-matching controllers use learned trajectory distributions together with costs, advantages, or constraint signals during sampling and online adaptation. The approaches improve feasible action selection and can adjust execution without retraining the original policy.

topics.name: Visual representation learning for robot policies
topics.summary: Robot policies are analyzed through geometry-aware latent actions, patch-level visual bottlenecks, and transition representations tied to affordances. Navigation and transfer experiments indicate that compact, structured visual signals can preserve task-relevant change.

topics.name: Adaptive grasping and manipulation
topics.summary: Adaptive manipulation systems normalize object pose, store behavioral history, or sense contact through compliant mechanisms. Across varied configurations and partial observability, these representations improve reuse, recovery, and physical grasp adjustment.

topics.name: Action and trajectory representations for robot learning
topics.summary: Action codebooks and trajectory memories compress long interaction histories for autoregressive control and embodied navigation. The recurring benefit is lower token or sequence cost while retaining temporal dependencies needed for multi-step behavior.

topics.name: Data-efficient vision-language-action robot learning
topics.summary: Data-efficient vision-language-action methods learn from human video, text-rendered scenes, pseudo-actions, modular knowledge, and predicted views rather than large action-labeled datasets. Tests emphasize unseen objects, occlusion, failure recovery, and limited demonstrations.

topics.name: Learning-based robot manipulation and planning
topics.summary: Learned manipulation planners represent action modes, effect-grounded latents, global energy corrections, and critic-ranked outcomes. Simulation and physical-robot evaluations report better success or fewer failures when local policies are supplemented with structured planning signals.

topics.name: Robust robot control and navigation
topics.summary: Robust control systems combine visual feedback, lightweight failure monitors, thermal or kinematic constraints, barrier-based objective switching, and proprioceptive fallbacks. Hardware experiments target unusual states and degraded sensors rather than nominal demonstrations alone.

topics.name: Geometry-aware manipulation planning
topics.summary: Geometry-conditioned manipulation uses point-cloud control features and diffusion trajectory priors that encode collision or rigid-soft-body constraints. The methods transfer from simulated planning to hardware while preserving feasible rotations, contacts, and paths.

topics.name: Temporal-logic robot and multi-agent verification
topics.summary: Temporal-logic methods specify spatial relationships, communication bounds, and reachability for robots and decentralized teams. Synthesis surveys and offline monitors connect formal task requirements with executable plans and post-run protocol analysis.

topics.name: Autonomous and cooperative driving
topics.summary: Driving studies combine cooperative vector messages, generative trajectory planning, masked reinforcement-learning batches, and separated camera views for instruction grounding. The shared application is efficient closed-loop behavior with reduced communication or training imbalance.

topics.name: Autonomous sensing, localization, and cyber-physical security
topics.summary: Autonomous sensing work fuses RGB, thermal, 3D, radio, maritime, and device-network observations with reliability-aware estimation, federated learning, digital twins, or honeypot decisions. Applications span localization, infrastructure inspection, threat detection, and IoMT defense.

topics.name: Magnetically actuated soft robotics
topics.summary: Magnetically reconfigurable elastomers and soft swimmers reshape microchannels, propel small bodies, or steer liquid delivery. Spatial magnetization and tunable stiffness recur as mechanisms for remote mixing, transport, locomotion, and targeting.

topics.name: Long-horizon reinforcement learning
topics.summary: Long-horizon reinforcement learning uses adaptive return composition, temporal reward shaping, coverage-oriented pretraining, and predictive dynamics. Offline control, language agents, and visual or low-dimensional tasks all benefit from better credit assignment or exploration signals.

topics.name: Continuous-time probabilistic forecasting
topics.summary: Continuous-time forecasters combine latent transition models or learned error corrections with physical and simulated process models. Sparse, irregular, and long-horizon observations are handled with improved multimodal predictions and uncertainty estimates.

topics.name: Spatiotemporal traffic forecasting
topics.summary: Traffic models separate link activation from demand magnitude and partition large sensor networks into balanced spatial regions. Graph connectivity, temporal variation, and inexpensive global interactions improve forecasting while controlling computational scale.

topics.name: Generative image compression and enhancement
topics.summary: Low-rate image codecs pair generative priors, token-specialized experts, implicit neural representations, and inference-time enhancement objectives. Experiments balance human perceptual quality, shadow recovery, machine utility, bitrate, and deployment cost.

topics.name: Bayesian posterior inference and compression
topics.summary: Bayesian methods compress redundant support distributions into validated regions and factorize inverse-imaging posteriors for faster sampling. Both preserve uncertainty while reducing the storage or computation required for posterior analysis.

topics.name: Uncertainty-aware image segmentation
topics.summary: Segmentation methods represent ambiguity with diverse architecture samples, promptable decoders, anatomical alignment, and conflict-aware multimodal evidence. Medical and forensic tests show that calibrated alternatives can expose uncertainty where a single mask is misleading.

topics.name: Domain-robust and weakly supervised image segmentation
topics.summary: Cross-domain segmentation methods use latent transport, adversarial shifts, teacher-student adaptation, boundary-distance decoding, morphology-aware privacy training, and native-space models. MRI, industrial, ultrastructural, and biomedical tests target scanner, anatomy, and label scarcity shifts.

topics.name: Clinically grounded medical vision
topics.summary: Radiology resources and clinically informed models evaluate lesion localization, attributes, diagnostic reasoning, MRI structure, seizure concepts, and patient-facing descriptions. Expert labels and anatomy or concept priors reveal that detailed justification is harder than detecting a coarse abnormality.

topics.name: Computational pathology
topics.summary: Pathology systems use spatial transcriptomics, pathway cues, tissue anchors, and region retrieval to connect whole-slide morphology with gene estimates, biomarkers, and prognosis. Sparse molecular evidence is treated as guidance for visual reasoning rather than a disconnected feature block.

topics.name: Physics-guided computational imaging
topics.summary: Differentiable ray and wave-optics models, synthetic diffusion images, and physics-based MRI optimization address calibration, reconstruction, and landmark detection. X-ray, CT, and EPI experiments show gains when measurement geometry and data consistency are included in learning.

topics.name: 3D scene understanding and geometry estimation
topics.summary: 3D perception studies address scale changes, moving viewpoints, temporal consistency, semantic lifting from foundation features, depth, and aerial monocular detection. Results show that stable geometry and reliable depth remain central bottlenecks for scene understanding.

topics.name: Data-efficient spectral imaging
topics.summary: Hyperspectral methods synthesize labeled spectra and recover masked wavelength channels to augment scarce training data. Classification improves while wavelength analysis helps identify which spectral regions carry discriminative information.

topics.name: Fine-grained multimodal vision and classification
topics.summary: Fine-grained multimodal models use region captions, localized labels, neighborhood consistency, class-specific prompts, and cross-modal adaptation. Image and video evaluations target detailed recognition, captioning, detection, and discovery of categories absent from training.

topics.name: Video-based human behavior recognition
topics.summary: Video behavior systems model skeletal motion, procedural errors, and facial dynamics with temporal encoders, language supervision, zero-shot transfer, and diverse human labels. The benchmarks show gains in fine-grained recognition while retaining uncertainty around subjective expressions.

topics.name: Diffusion-based domain adaptation
topics.summary: Diffusion generators create target-style or out-of-domain visual samples using instance tokens, learned domain prompts, and category-preserving conditioning. Domain adaptation and generalization tests report stronger transfer when synthetic variation reflects the deployment shift.

topics.name: Geometric representation and generative modeling
topics.summary: Geometric generative methods use manifold-aware transport, functional orthogonality, structured probes, and text constraints for quantum states, disentangled factors, CAD variants, and crystal candidates. Their evaluations connect intrinsic geometry and identifiability to controllable scientific design.

topics.name: Mechanistic interpretability of neural representations
topics.summary: Mechanistic studies use spectral probes, sparse dictionaries, attention statistics, attribution, circuit recovery, and compressed routing signals. Across language and transformer models, these tools localize features, trace information flow, and support targeted steering, ablation, or rewiring.

topics.name: Human motion generation
topics.summary: Motion diffusion systems condition generation on semantics, audio, body structure, and signer or performer characteristics, with local continuity controls. Applications include expressive motion and long-sentence sign production, where temporal coordination is the main challenge.

topics.name: Security of video generation models
topics.summary: Video-generation security methods perturb released clips to resist unauthorized personalization and poison future-dynamics learning so triggers alter generated objects. The findings frame both data release and model training as temporal attack surfaces.

topics.name: Speaker and voice representation learning
topics.summary: Speaker-aware audio models disentangle identity from pitch, linguistic content, expression, and non-verbal vocalization. Pitch-conditioned codecs, contrastive verification, distillation, listener studies, and reconstruction tests expose identity leakage and intelligibility trade-offs.

topics.name: Reservoir computing for signal analysis
topics.summary: Reservoir computing uses fixed recurrent dynamics with simple readouts for raw audio classification and online regime-change detection. The lightweight models remain sensitive to subtle temporal anomalies, including signals relevant to clinical monitoring.

topics.name: Deployable neural audio systems
topics.summary: Audio systems are compiled into verified real-time DSP or protected with watermarks designed to survive distortion, removal attempts, and downstream training. These methods address deployability, provenance, and robustness at the product boundary.

topics.name: Speech generation and robust spoken-language understanding
topics.summary: Discrete-audio language models are adapted with text supervision, event controls, acoustic-semantic alignment, lexical retrieval, and perceptual or recognition rewards. Low-resource, noisy, disfluent, and spontaneous speech tasks show gains in enhancement, synthesis, and intent recovery.

topics.name: Machine learning for physiological sensing and control
topics.summary: Physiological interfaces combine temporal models and optical representations for free-living heart-rate or contactless respiration, while EEG and insulin-control systems reduce calibration or improve interpretable closed-loop decisions. Cross-user transfer and practical trust are recurring evaluation goals.

topics.name: Neural audio-codec deepfake detection
topics.summary: Codec-generated heart sounds and age-diverse speech expose weak cross-domain generalization in ordinary deepfake detectors. Spectral, self-supervised, and multimodal foundation features improve discrimination across biomedical and voice-forensic benchmarks.

topics.name: Expressive music modeling
topics.summary: Music sequence models control recurring motifs and transfer synthetic intensity labels to guitar transcription. Lightweight temporal architectures improve structure or expressive velocity prediction beyond note identity alone.

topics.name: Physics-informed scientific machine learning
topics.summary: Scientific surrogate methods combine adaptive spectral operators, orthogonal residual processes, equality-constrained dynamics, and scale-aware turbulence compression. Fluid and other physical benchmarks reward models that preserve invariants, spectra, or calibrated uncertainty while reducing simulation cost.

topics.name: Causal inference and discovery
topics.summary: Causal studies analyze instability from point summaries of structural uncertainty and scalable nonlinear graph recovery via local Markov boundaries and synthetic pretraining. The shared concern is identifying structure without hiding uncertainty or relying on exhaustive global search.

topics.name: Graph-structured neural dynamics
topics.summary: Structured connectivity is built into neural computation through neuron-level graph dynamics and Ramanujan-inspired rewiring. Sequence and message-passing experiments link topology to information flow, collective behavior, and long-range coordination.

topics.name: Operational event sequence modeling
topics.summary: Operational event models encode categorical, numerical, and temporal records with hierarchical attention, event-specific features, imbalance handling, and online updates. Fraud and workflow streams benefit when the model adapts as event distributions change.

topics.name: Sparse graph and tensor recommendation
topics.summary: Sparse recommendation methods combine tensor completion, attention, contrastive signals, and Krylov-space graph filtering. The results improve missing-interaction recovery while limiting memory use and avoiding explicit construction of large item-similarity matrices.

topics.name: Convergence theory for adaptive optimization
topics.summary: Convergence analyses cover averaged Adam, anchored optimistic updates, and Muon-style refinement near solutions. The results characterize stochastic noise, last-iterate acceleration, and geometry-dependent behavior rather than relying only on empirical training curves.

topics.name: Foundation models for time-series classification
topics.summary: Pretrained tabular foundations are adapted to time-series classification with causal synthetic priors or random convolution features. UCR and UEA evaluations test zero-shot or light-adaptation performance across varied channels and temporal patterns.

topics.name: AI governance, agentic evaluation, and social effects
topics.summary: These studies examine how AI systems should be evaluated and constrained in public use, from forecasting infrastructure and feedback aggregation to open-weight capability controls, international agreements, warning labels, visibility bias, user experience, and online participation.

topics.name: Robot sensing, dynamics, and vehicle design
topics.summary: Robotic systems are designed around the physical details that determine reliable operation: handover quality, scanner settings, continuum-body state estimation, buoyancy-driven underwater motion, and mission-level trades for small planetary vehicles.

topics.name: Physical scene modeling with 3D Gaussian representations
topics.summary: Several 3D Gaussian methods move beyond photorealistic rendering toward compact reconstruction and physical interaction. Their shared concern is retaining geometry, contacts, and scene-level behavior while reducing representation cost.

topics.name: Robust visual perception across domains
topics.summary: Visual perception pipelines target difficult deployment shifts, including aerial disaster scenes, synthetic-to-real pose transfer, degraded LiDAR, and moving-object localization. The methods emphasize geometry-aware features, motion priors, or lightweight detectors for uncommon conditions.

topics.name: Medical imaging datasets and segmentation
topics.summary: Medical vision resources address annotation-intensive structure discovery across connectomes, chest radiographs, histopathology, and cerebral vessels. They pair specialized representations or hardware with curated labels and evaluation protocols for fine-grained clinical structure.

topics.name: Multimodal sensing under shift and scarce labels
topics.summary: These sensing systems combine cameras, physiological signals, environmental measurements, or animal behavior cues when labels are limited and conditions vary by subject, site, or season. Adaptation and cross-modal agreement are used to make deployment measurements more dependable.

topics.name: Speech and music generation systems
topics.summary: Audio generation work adapts neural synthesis to interactive music, older listeners, accented operational speech, engine sound design, and fast text-to-speech. Across settings, controllable conditioning and efficient representations connect perceptual quality with real-time or user-specific constraints.

topics.name: Speech evaluation, enhancement, and audio safety
topics.summary: Speech and audio models are assessed for trustworthy behavior through multi-reference prosody scoring, cross-lingual ASR metrics, phoneme-aware enhancement, and refusal tests. The same cluster also exposes training-time backdoors and modality-specific over-refusal risks.

topics.name: Language-model mechanisms and grounding
topics.summary: Mechanistic and architectural analyses trace how language models combine local and global features, represent references, retrieve facts, and expose internal concepts. The studies also examine whether model lineage leaves detectable signals after distillation.

topics.name: Evidence-aware retrieval and document QA
topics.summary: Document QA systems are made more auditable by retrieving context across legal references, exposing claim-to-source support, steering embedding features, and comparing document, query, and answer-side retrieval choices. The common goal is complete evidence rather than fluent unsupported answers.

topics.name: Cross-lingual and cultural language evaluation
topics.summary: Language evaluation is extended across Japanese-English translation, case-specific translation error rubrics, low-resource polarization detection, and culturally grounded multimodal reasoning. These benchmarks emphasize language, culture, and task-specific criteria that broad English scores can miss.

topics.name: AI deployment security and data protection
topics.summary: Deployment-facing security studies combine source auditing, adaptive cache controls, threat classification, and adversarial-training analysis. They focus on implementation vulnerabilities, data leakage or copying, calibrated detection, and the limits of treating robustness as a generic regularizer.

topics.name: Efficient language-model serving and training
topics.summary: Systems research improves large-model throughput through KV-cache policies, quantization studies, CPU-GPU cache cooperation, event-driven batch execution, and tree-structured parallel training. The papers treat memory movement and scheduling as central constraints alongside model quality.

topics.name: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon and structured decisions
topics.summary: These reinforcement-learning studies improve decisions when rewards are sparse, objectives conflict, dynamics are differentiable, or plans must extend beyond one step. They use offline-to-online adaptation, world models, policy diagnostics, analytic gradients, and formal entropy or coverage objectives.

topics.name: Statistical learning theory and private inference
topics.summary: Theoretical studies characterize finite-sample behavior and model selection for logistic regression, kernel methods, copulas, censored outcomes, and privacy-preserving estimation. Their shared emphasis is on guarantees, uncertainty, and computational trade-offs beyond benchmark accuracy.

topics.name: Continual, graph, and unsupervised representation learning
topics.summary: Representation-learning methods adapt to streams, relational schemas, and unlabeled data by learning graph structure, reusing recurring regimes, or clustering through agreement. The papers investigate how modularity and stability can replace large labels or fixed similarity assumptions.

topics.name: Optimization, allocation, and collective decision theory
topics.summary: Optimization papers study bilevel computation, multidimensional allocation, learned shortcuts for mixed-integer programs, belief revision costs, and coalition reconfiguration. Together they connect algorithmic efficiency with fairness, uncertainty, and strategic interaction among decision makers.

topics.name: Scientific machine learning and digital twins
topics.summary: Scientific ML applications use Bayesian optimization, perturbation-response benchmarks, quantum or classical molecular kernels, power-grid structure, planetary reanalysis, and experiment-anchored materials validation. The recurring concern is whether learned models remain useful when physical references and operating regimes change.

topics.name: Controllable and data-efficient image generation
topics.summary: Image-generation studies reduce data or improve control through object-centric resources, test-time feedback, preference-based post-training, geometric inpainting, token-level dataset analysis, and causal latent variables. Each approach links generative quality to structure, supervision, or downstream use.

topics.name: Video understanding, human activity, and multimodal interaction
topics.summary: Multimodal perception systems analyze dense classroom behavior, long videos, audio-video continuity, and unlabeled inertial activity. They address temporal context and interaction through hierarchical reasoning, cross-shot memory, or sensor fusion rather than isolated frame classification.
